title: Let's Play Dragon Warrior III NES | Part 1 - Warriors of Aliahan!
note: Frames are the 4:3 NES window cropped from the 854x480 segment source at 124,16 608x456 and scaled to 256x192, then mapped onto the 64-entry NES palette. Mean luminance per screen matches the source within one level.

transitions.name: Corridor walk
transitions.detail: First-person dungeon view. Each step repaints the whole view in whole-tile jumps; nothing scrolls smoothly.

transitions.name: Fade to black
transitions.detail: The screen collapses to black in two discrete steps about 0.03s apart (mean luminance 35 -> 15 -> 0.8). Every colour is swapped for a darker palette entry; it is not a dissolve.

transitions.name: Black hold
transitions.detail: A flat black screen for 1.77s. On hardware this is where the next room is loaded and drawn.

transitions.name: Fade up from black
transitions.detail: Two discrete steps back up (0.2 -> 6.0 -> 12.7). This is the measured model for the interstitial's exit.

transitions.name: Room draw
transitions.detail: The next room is painted in progressively; mean luminance climbs from 12.7 to about 31 as tiles fill in.

transitions.name: Room reveal
transitions.detail: The room switches to its lit palette over about eight frames; mean luminance 22 -> 99.

transitions.name: Lit room
transitions.detail: Steady lit room with the stairs. The view animates continuously.

transitions.name: Dim out
transitions.detail: The view dims again at the end of the segment.
